1  ACQUISITION ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND DECREE  DATED 18.04.2022 PASSED IN LAC(APPEAL) NO.198/2017 ON  THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS  JUDGE, HASSAN, PARTLY ALLOWING THE APPEAL AND  MODIFYING THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 11.03.2016  PASSED IN LAC 32/2014 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL  JUDGE AND JMFC, ARAKALGUD, PARTLY ALLOWING THE  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:35129  MSA No. 164 of 2024 HC-KAR PETITIONS FILED UNDER SECTIONS 18(1) OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER Heard Sri Manoj Kumar J.Y., learned counsel for the appellant, Sri Gopalkrishna Soodi, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri B.R. Prashanth, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2.

Joint memo is filed, which reads as under:
"It is respectfully submitted
that this Hon'ble Court Co-ordinate Bench in M.S.A.No.24/2023 c/w 25/23 had enhanced the compensation to Rs.45,000/- per gunta vide order dated 15.11.2024.
It is now prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to pass an order in the above cases in accordance with the M.S.A.No.24/23 c/w 25/23, in the interest of justice and equity."

3. This Court in respect of the very same project has enhanced the compensation amount in a sum of Rs.10,000/- as NC: 2025:KHC:35129 HC-KAR against the order of the First Appellate Court granting Rs.35,000/- per gunta.
4.
In the present case, the claimant is also entitled for Rs.45,000/- per gunta, in view of the order passed in MSA No.24/2023 C/w MSA No.25/2023.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER Smt Shanthamallappa vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43321857/
2 (i) Miscellaneous Second Appeal is allowed.
